title: Venice Beach Recreation Center – Project Approval for a Gift of Paddle Tennis
text:
Venice Beach Recreation Center – Project Approval for a Gift of Paddle Tennis
  Court Improvements from the Los Angeles Parks Foundation Funded Through
  Donations from Venice Community Residents and Various Organizations –
  Approval of Donor Recognition Signage – Categorically Exempt from the
  Provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article
  19, Section 15301(d) [Restoration or Rehabilitation of Deteriorated or Damaged
  Structures, Facilities, or Mechanical Equipment to Meet Current Standards of
  Public Health and Safety] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section
  1, Class 1(4) of City CEQA Guidelines
summary: Project approval for gift of paddle tennis court improvements at Venice Beach Recreation Center from the Los Angeles Parks Foundation.

details.action: project approval for donated court improvements
